items.imageCaption: Image caption, Vithabhai Narayangaonkar was a legend in Maharashtra's folk theatre | Image caption, Eetha hits the theatres on 5 December
items.author: Amrita Kadam
items.excerpt: Few things could keep Vithabai Narayangaonkar, one of the greatest stars of Maharashtra's folk theatre, away from the stage. In the 1960s, the singer, dancer and troupe leader was performing in Shikhar Shingnapur, a village in the western Indian state, when she went into labour. "She quietly stepped behind the stage into a makeshift tent while the rest of us continued performing," her daughter, veteran folk artist Mangala Bansode, told BBC Marathi. items.title: Türkiye's 800-year-old mosque with leaning minaret undergoes major restoration
items.author: Newsroom
items.excerpt: The historic Sivas Grand Mosque (Ulu Cami), one of the most recognizable landmarks in central Türkiye, is undergoing the most comprehensive restoration in its history, with work expected to wrap up by the end of 2027. Dating back to the Anatolian Seljuk period, the mosque stands out for its distinctive brick minaret, which leans 1.17 meters (3.84 feet) from its vertical axis. The mosque was closed to worship approximately 16 months ago as restoration teams set out to strengthen its foundations, recover its original architectural features and preserve its leaning minaret.
